parameters.status: Full-robot kinematic packaging candidate; not a dynamics model or manufacturing release.

budget.scope: Four motors and two springs only; all controllers, transmission hardware, internal-knee metalwork, battery, tax and delivery extra.

spring.procurement_status: Previously checked estimate; price is not reconfirmed for this model

jump_motor.caution: DC-equivalent BLDC model. Kv/Kt, current and resistance conventions must be calibrated to the FOC driver. Manufacturer 32 A/30 s assumes propeller cooling; sealed joint thermal rating is unknown. Rotor inertia estimated from a 21 g thin ring at 13.8 mm. Encoder and bidirectional FOC required.

wheel_motor.status: Packaging selection only. FOC, encoder, torque-speed model, thermal rating, adapter and gear procurement unqualified.
wheel_motor.caution: DC-equivalent model; 8 A assumed current limit, not a thermal rating. Resistance/current/FOC conventions require bench identification. Manufacturer propeller test rating does not establish sealed duty.

parameters.mass_status: CAD-derived mass/inertia estimate, not weighed or sliced.
parameters.model_limits: CAD-derived but unweighed mass/inertia; closed internal linkages; actual exterior convex hulls for ground contacts; current/voltage-limited motor models with assumed conventions and losses. No self-contact, joint flexibility, gearbox backlash, temperature or hardware qualification.

report.controller: Behavior cloning / normalized ONNX / CPU MuJoCo
